name: Bali, Indonesia
tagline: Emerald rice terraces and hidden waterfalls
description: Trek through jungle waterfalls, greet the sunrise from a volcano summit, and relax on black-sand beaches.

name: Mount Fuji, Japan
description: Watch the sunset paint the sky behind Mount Fuji from a hillside pagoda, wrapped in a sea of blooming cherry blossoms.

name: Thailand
description: Explore ornate Buddhist temples, drift through floating markets, and unwind on limestone-flanked beaches.

name: Malaysia
description: Wander ancient rainforest trails by day and take in Kuala Lumpur's skyline from a rooftop bar by night.

name: Singapore
description: Walk beneath the glowing Supertrees, sample hawker-stall favorites, and catch the skyline from Marina Bay.

name: Vietnam
description: Cruise past limestone karsts in Ha Long Bay, cycle through rice paddies, and wander the lantern-lit lanes of Hoi An.

name: Bhutan
description: Trek to the Tiger's Nest monastery clinging to a cliffside and experience the last Buddhist kingdom's untouched valleys.

name: Maldives
description: Snorkel over vibrant coral reefs, watch the sunset from an overwater villa, and slow down on your own private sandbar.

name: UAE Dubai
description: Ride the dunes on a desert safari, ascend the world's tallest tower, and shop beneath the world's largest indoor aquarium.

name: Ladakh
description: Ride past snow-capped mountain passes, camp beside Pangong Lake, and explore centuries-old Buddhist monasteries in the trans-Himalayan desert.

name: Jammu & Kashmir
description: Drift on a shikara across Dal Lake, ski the slopes of Gulmarg, and wander through Mughal gardens framed by snow peaks.

name: Himachal Pradesh
description: Trek through pine forests, sip tea in colonial hill towns, and watch the sunrise over snow-capped Himalayan peaks.

name: Goa
description: Unwind on golden beaches, explore whitewashed churches, and dance the night away at a beachside shack.

name: Kerala
description: Cruise the backwaters on a houseboat, wander tea plantations in Munnar, and relax on Kerala's palm-fringed beaches.

name: Tamil Nadu
description: Wander towering Dravidian temple gopurams, explore colonial-era Pondicherry, and unwind on the Coromandel coast.

name: Karnataka
description: Explore Mysore's royal palaces, hike through coffee plantations in Coorg, and discover ancient ruins in Hampi.

name: Sikkim
description: Trek beneath the world's third-highest peak, visit cliffside monasteries, and drive through terraced valleys of flowers.

name: Andaman Islands
description: Snorkel over vibrant coral reefs, relax on Radhanagar's white sands, and step back in time at the historic Cellular Jail.

name: Arunachal Pradesh
tagline: Untouched valleys of the eastern Himalayas
description: Journey through remote monasteries, cross high mountain passes, and discover one of India's least-explored corners.

name: Hallstatt, Austria
tagline: A snow-dusted lakeside village in the Alps
description: Wander cobblestone lanes beneath a soaring church spire, watch lantern light reflect off the lake, and take in the Alps blanketed in snow.

name: Rajasthan
tagline: Golden forts and desert camps under the stars
description: Ride a camel across the Thar Desert at sunset, wander the sandstone ramparts of Jaisalmer Fort, and spend the night at a candlelit desert camp.

name: Paris, France
tagline: Iron towers and rain-lit cobblestone streets
description: Stand beneath the Eiffel Tower by day and watch it glow in tricolor at night, then wander cobblestone lanes scattered with autumn leaves.
